Title: Overall you can should buy realme 15x , or u can buy this also but i suggest realme 15x .
Body:
First of all, I would like to talk about my Realme Narzo 80 Pro 5G. Overall, it is a very good phone in the 20–22k INR price range. I have been using this phone since 17 August 2025, and today is 28 November 2025—almost 4 months. The gaming performance is very good. The camera quality is also very good in bright environments such as sunlight or outdoors, especially when taking photos of people. Nature photography is also decent. Also sound quality is also good , i'm reading some negative comments , but i want to tell to whomever reading this review , The phone has dual stereo speaker support also , with 300% voice boost .I have the 8 GB RAM + 128 GB storage variant. I strongly suggest buying the 256 GB storage variant because in the 128 GB version, a large portion of the storage is taken by the system—around 30–40 GB. So, you only get about 60–70 GB of usable space, which is quite low for modern usage. Even though the phone is advertised as 128 GB, you don’t actually get the full 128 GB.In terms of performance, I did not face any heating issues. The phone stays cool during normal and even heavy tasks. It only heats slightly while charging, which is completely normal for fast-charging phones. The connectivity is also very good, with strong Wi-Fi and Bluetooth performance. Storage transfer speeds are fast as well, thanks to UFS 3.1 storage.I also appreciate the battery capacity, which is quite good for modern phones (6000 mAh). The battery lasts around 20–21 hours with moderate usage such as YouTube, Instagram Reels, or studying on the PW app. However, I have one issue with the screen. Although the display is very bright, easy to use in sunlight, and has excellent color quality, I would advise avoiding phones with curved displays. If a curved screen breaks after dropping on a cemented road or anywhere else, it is very difficult to find a duplicate replacement screen in the market.Additionally, you cannot expand the memory using an SD card, and there is no audio jack on this phone. On the positive side, the 80W charging is amazing—it charges the phone up to 25% in just 10 minutes and more than 60% in under 30 minutes.Overall, the phone is very good, but I still recommend checking out the Realme 15x. It offers almost the same features and is even better in some aspects because it doesn’t have a curved display. The Realme 15x also comes with 60W SUPERVOOC charging and a massive 7000 mAh battery, which is extremely impressive and lasts even longer.

Title: Amazing battery and performance, okay camera.
Body:
This is a great phone overall, the battery is the best I've ever had in a smartphone. I fully charge it in the morning and when I return home in the evening at 7 pm, the battery is still around 80%! I routinely end the day at around 65% battery, it can last 2 full dyas on normal usage. The charging is also super fast, it goes from 0 to 65 in under 30 minutes, and the fast charger is included in the box.The screen is fantastic, 120 Hz display and bright colours. The performance is also top notch, the phone feels very snappy and quick, I don't bother closing apps because the phone can hold as many apps as I want without slowing down. The only thing that's not the best in class, is the camera. The main camera is still very good, 50 megapizels and takes great photos, which are processed with AI to enhance their features. The ultrawide is not that good, and the front camera is average for the price. It's not a bad camera setup at all, still very good, but certainly below what you expect from a 50k phone.In summary, performace, battery and screen are amazing, camera is good but not great. If you want a reliable and fast phone that has a monster battery and super fast charging, go for this one.

Title: Feedback
Body:
I purchased boAt earbuds, but unfortunately my experience has been very disappointing. Please find my feedback below:There is no proper indication to know whether the earbuds are fully charged or how much battery percentage is currently available. This makes charging very inconvenient.The total battery life is only around 12 hours. Even if I charge the earbuds in the morning at 8 AM, they completely stop working by around 7–8 PM.The touch sensitivity is very poor. Even a slight accidental touch pauses the music or video. Overall, the touch controls do not work properly.Most importantly, after using the earbuds for some time, the audio starts breaking continuously. Whether I am listening to music or watching videos, the sound keeps cutting off, which makes them very difficult to use.Overall, the product does not perform as expected and needs significant improvement in quality and performance.-VIJAY MISHRA, VADODARA
